name: Ren'ai Replay
source:
"Do you want to go back to those days?"
Mysterious message appear suddenly on smartphone. 
"Love replay has started. As much as possible, please fall in love this time" 
The next moment, with my memories, I'm back to my high school days. 
Close to you are your childhood friends who fall in love with you. You will once more find love.....?

Realistic heroines with "Live2D!" 
"Move", and "react", and "touch" 
Play these adorable girls' lover in real time, so you enjoy the story!
translation:
“你想回到那些日子吗？”
神秘的信息突然出现在手机上。
“恋爱重播已经开始了。请尽可能地恋爱吧。”
下一刻，带着记忆，我回到了高中时代。
身边是爱上了你的青梅竹马们。你会再次找到爱情吗……？

搭载Live2D的逼真女主角！
“移动”、“反应”和“触摸”
实时扮演这些可爱女孩的恋人，享受故事吧！
